question: Using the local bwm_ephys dataset, how many good units were recorded in visual cortex (the areas under VIS in the Allen hierarchy), split by hemisphere? And how many sessions have visual-cortex units in both hemispheres?
_notes: Ground truth from metadata/units.parquet (good units only) joined to the
Allen hierarchy: 1783 left (x < 0), 235 right (x > 0), 2018 total, over 88
sessions, 5 of which have both hemispheres.
Trap 1: filtering acronyms that start with 'VIS' gives 3094 units, because
it sweeps in VISC (the visceral area) plus VISa and VISrl, which Allen
places under posterior parietal, not visual. Only hierarchy descendants of
VIS are correct. Observed: mistral-small answered 2657/437, the split that
Trap 2: hemisphere is in neither atlas_id nor beryl_acronym; it comes from
the sign of the x coordinate.
Trap 3: the last part counts sessions, not units.
